why: Intro to the terminal plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-terminal.json), 'Make folders and files' (passes: trail-log holds notes and photos, and notes holds day1.txt, day2.txt and day3.txt). The learner made the folders, went into trail-log and ran touch there, without `cd notes`: `ls` shows day1.txt, day2.txt and day3.txt beside notes and photos. notes is empty. Every file exists, one folder too high.

step.title: Make the notes files
step.instructions: Make trail-log with two folders inside, notes and photos: mkdir -p trail-log/notes trail-log/photos. Then go into trail-log/notes and make day1.txt, day2.txt and day3.txt with touch.

Terminal: tripi@mac trail-log % touch day1.txt day2.txt day3.txt
